visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Counting with Counter
visualizerParams.description: collections.Counter counts how often each item occurs. most_common(n) lists the n most frequent items, and a missing item has the count 0.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
from collections import Counter

text = "the cat and the hat and the bat"
counts = Counter(text.split())
print(counts.most_common(2))
print(counts["the"], counts["dog"])
